neighbours.label: word-ending pieces 'ificial', 'quate', 'ards', 'actly' when the word is split because it has no leading space ("art|ificial", 'inade|quate', "stand|ards", "ex|actly")

The inspector wrote 'inadequate' across the top of the form.

The flavouring is listed as (artificial) on the back of the packet.

Type the folder name 'standards' into the search box.
